body.x: NDS Solution (CEO, Kim Nam Gyo) participated in the ‘CES 2017 (Consumer Technology Show) that is the world’s largest IT consumer electronics and consumer technology tradeshow held in Las Vegas in the United States from January 5th to January 8th as a Daegu Common Facility for the 3D Convergence Support Project of Daegu Technopark and exhibited a touch display new product.

The touch display by NDS is a display for both vertical and horizontal direction. NDS develops a digital signage as well as DID (Digital Information Display Manufacture), so it is possible to operate a signage program through the display.

The signage program, ‘Q-way Finder’ solution, is an internal drawing template of simple UI and allows users to produce a basic Q-way finder solution without a designer and programmer. Also, users can use videos, images, and others without program coding and upgrade advertising and path-finding effects. It is possible to manage effectively contents such as display in a shop and names of goods, route data, and more.

Furthermore, the Daegu Technopark and Smart Venture Institute and Smart Drone Technology Center of Kyungpook National University opened ‘CES Daegu Common Facility’ and supported the exhibition operation of 22 domestic enterprises and business meeting with a buyer.

CES (Consumer Technology Show), which is the world’s largest IT consumer electronics and consumer technology tradeshow, is a good opportunity to figure out the flow of the global electronic industry at a glance and is held on every January by CTA (Consumer Technology Association).

Aving News Korea, which have reported issues of CES, MWC, and IFA as the world’ three major technology exhibitions the most for the last 10 years, will send a special group of reporters to CES, report main issues of the markets, and introduce Korean enterprises all over the world this year.
